{
  "subject": "A reference for Jordan Rivera",
  "body": "Hi Sarah,

I am applying for senior software engineer roles in Melbourne, Australia and would be grateful if you were willing to act as a reference. My most recent work was leading 6 engineers on a payments platform at Canvatech in Python and PostgreSQL.

Please say no if it is not a good time. If you are happy to help, I will send the role details and the timing before naming you.

Thank you,
Jordan Rivera"
}
